extracted.intended_audience: conference reviewers using the Microsoft Conference Management Toolkit (CMT)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guide for reviewers using Microsoft CMT to accept invitations, access assigned submissions, download files, enter and submit reviews, import/export offline reviews, and save reviews as PDF. Focuses on using the CMT UI and required file/format conventions rather than evaluation content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review Invitation (Optional)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you receive a reviewer invitation email from a Chair of a Conference, you may accept the invitation by clicking the “accept” link. If you want to decline the invitation, click the “decline” link.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clicking the accept link will take you to the Manage Reviewer Invite page. A confirmation pop-up will appear. Click 'OK.' You have options to change your response to decline and/or to leave a comment. If a comment is entered, click Submit Comment to save.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer Console visibility / timing
rubrics_metrics.description: When you access the Reviewer Console, you may find that there are no papers to review. This only means the reviewing has not started.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Chair will send out an email to all Reviewers to start reviewing papers. Once reviewing has started, the paper(s) assigned to you will appear in the Reviewer Console.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission Questions visibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Sometimes chairs will have submission questions for authors to answer upon submitting a paper. These answers are visible in the Submission Summary page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To view, click the Paper ID number. The submission summary shows the answers by authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: View Abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: The abstract can be viewed in a couple of places.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It can be viewed in the Submission Summary right under the paper title or in the Reviewer Console by clicking “Show Abstract” link. The abstract appears under the title of the Paper. To download the files individually, click the “Download” link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Downloading submission files
rubrics_metrics.description: Files can be downloaded in a couple of places.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In the Submission Summary page, just click the link for the file. To download all the files at once, in the Reviewer Console click the Actions dropdown and select “Download Files.” Save the paper to your computer. Note: If there are multiple files for a paper, a zip file will be downloaded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entering an online review
rubrics_metrics.description: To enter review online, click “Enter Review” link to go to the “Edit Review” page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Enter Review link in the Reviewer Console to open the form for editing your review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Edit Review / Review Questions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edit Review page has qualifying questions added by the Chair.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The questions could consist of statements of agreement, multiple choice, or limited-character text field types. Depending upon conference parameters set by the Chair, you can see information about your answer visibility to other roles (e.g., reviewers or meta-reviewers). All required fields are marked by an asterisk <*>.

rubrics_metrics.name: Save draft behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: CMT automatically saves a draft every few minutes. You can also click “Save Draft” at any time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After saving the draft, it will show the timestamp of the save in the lower right.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit review
rubrics_metrics.description: When you are satisfied with your answers, click Submit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Important: Only the Chairs can delete a review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confirmation email after submission
rubrics_metrics.description: After submitting the review, a confirmation email will automatically be sent to the Reviewer (and the Chair, if enabled for notification of reviews).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example email text format shown: 'Reviewer ABC submitted a review for paper XXX in conference YYY.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-submission console options
rubrics_metrics.description: After submitting your review, you will be directed back to the Reviewer Console.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note that now you have options to view the Review as well as to edit the Review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Import Reviews (offline reviews) — general constraint
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewers have the option to review the paper offline and import the review via an XML file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Offline reviews must be done in a text editor using the same XML file that was downloaded. It cannot be copy and pasted into Word.

rubrics_metrics.name: Import Reviews — download and edit XML
rubrics_metrics.description: To import offline reviews: Click the Actions dropdown and select Import Reviews. Enable the checkbox(es) for the Paper(s) you wish to review offline, then click Download.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This will download an XML file which you will modify, then re-upload to CMT. Save the XML file locally. Open the file in a text editor (e.g., Notepad). The first line will always be the Conference Short Name. If multiple papers are selected, each Paper will have its own section in the XML. In the lines where it states 'Your answer' you will replace the words 'Your answer' (between the '><'), with your actual answers to the questions, usually taken from the options given in the XML. For example, if questions have options for answers, choose one of the options listed as your answer. If questions have no options, enter your answer in text, as in question number 4. Save the XML; either with the same name or a different name of your choosing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Upload reviews (re-importing edited XML)
rubrics_metrics.description: In the Upload Reviews section of the Import Reviews page, click Upload.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the saved XML (with your answers), click Open. The Import Reviews page shows the file uploaded successfully. Click on View for any of the reviews you want to verify. This will bring up the View Review page for the corresponding Paper.

rubrics_metrics.name: View Review page navigation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click Go Back to return to the Reviewer Console.

rubrics_metrics.name: Save review as PDF
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click 'Destination' dropdown and select 'Save to PDF'. Click Save and select the folder where you want to save it.
